turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
· Just now

Bot · AI

Bot · AI says:
Great question! Nelly.com ships internationally, but outside the EU, delivery is currently limited to the United Kingdom and Switzerland. For these destinations, local sales tax/VAT and import charges—such as customs duties—aren’t included in the checkout price and may be charged when the parcel reaches the border. These fees are the customer’s responsibility, so duty and taxes may be due upon arrival. 📦

Great question! Standard shipping usually takes 3–7 business days, depending on the destination: 4–6 in Germany; 3–5 in Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Poland; 4–7 in France, the rest of the EU, and the UK; and 3–6 in Switzerland. Please also allow up to 3 business days for your order to be shipped, so the total time from placing your order to delivery may be longer than the shipping time alone. 📦
